name: trait-S02-spots-a
refs: Our signed young S02, Untuva (project-owned): the creature, exactly. Its body is bare (no markings) and its cap is the 'between' span.
prompt: Paint FOUR panels in a 2 by 2 grid, equal size, a small gap between them, on plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no borders, no text. All four show the SAME whole creature as the reference (the round warm chestnut puffball body, the ochre-tan cap, the eyes and peach blush, same pose, same brush and soft painterly light from the top left), the whole creature large in each panel with clear magenta around it. Only markings on the chestnut BODY change, painted in a paler sand tone in the same brushwork; the cap never changes. TOP LEFT, 'bare': exactly the reference, no markings. TOP RIGHT, 'bands': soft pale sand bands wrapping around the body. BOTTOM LEFT, 'spots': soft pale sand spots scattered over the body. BOTTOM RIGHT, 'bands and spots': the bands and the spots together. Face, cap, pose, size and light identical in all four. No props, no ground, no shadow, no glow.
